posts.text: The 2s10s Treasury yield curve un-inversion is proceeding faster than the market priced in. Keep a close eye on high-yield credit spreads and real GDP revisions.

posts.text: The global monetary cycle is approaching a critical divergence. While the Federal Reserve begins monetary easing, central bank reserve managers are structurally diversifying foreign exchange holdings away from standard G7 sovereign debt into physical gold and decentralized collateral like Bitcoin. Global balance sheet adjustments take years to play out.

posts.text: 很多人问为什么黄金屡创历史新高而商品原油却在震荡？核心在于“信用锚”与“生产力锚”的分野。黄金代表的是对主权信用货币长期购买力贬值的对冲，而原油受制于实体经济产出与制造业周期的现实约束。BTC 作为数字形态的硬通货，其长期估值模型与黄金正在发生日益深度的协同共振。
